title: Serval, which offers AI agents for enterprise IT operations like access management, raised $150M led by Sequoia at a $3B valuation, up from $1B in December 2025 (Harshita Mary Varghese/Reuters)
summary: Harshita Mary Varghese / Reuters: Serval, which offers AI agents for enterprise IT operations like access management, raised $150M led by Sequoia at a $3B valuation, up from $1B in December 2025 — Serval raised $150 million in a Sequoia-led round at a $3 billion valuation, as the enterprise automation company seeks …
